items.information: ## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. - Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings. For 4x4, we will accept a maximum of 24 competitors. If you have 4x4 in your event list after 24 other people sign up for 4x4, it will be removed from your registration when you get accepted.

You can choose on which day of the competition you will participate for one or all the days of the competition.. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIzMTM5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fa678d03dc99824a0120880dd846920c02be36f5/Latvijas%20(1).png) Gada nozīmīgākās sacensības Latvijā atgriežas – **Latvijas čempionāts**! Sacensībās būs pārstāvētas gandrīz visas oficiālās WCA disciplīnas, kā arī notiks Iesācēju kauss, lai piešķirtu pasākumam nelielu odziņu. Balvas varēs saņemt tikai Latvijas pilsoņi, taču sacensībās piedalīties aicināti dalībnieki no jebkuras valsts. "Kluso" disciplīnu čempionāts notiks atsevišķi 28. un 29. novembrī. Reģistrēties klusajam čempionātam var [šajā lapā](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LatvijasKlusaiscempionats2026) Šīs būs jau sestās sacensības, kas norisināsies Siguldā. ----------------------------------------------------- The most important competitton of the year in Latvia returns – **Latvian Championship**! Amost all official WCA events will be featured, along with a Beginners’ Cup to add a little twist to the competition. Only Latvian citizens are eligible for prizes, but participants from any country are welcome to compete. The Silent Championship will be held separately on 28th and 29th November. Register for the Silent Championship at [this site](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LatvijasKlusaiscempionats2026) This will be the sixth competition to take place in Sigulda. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1MjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2c629bcad5d3a8ac071c808aa84be23cd16d534/cuboss-logo-400px.png)

items.information: ## Welcome to the Malaysia Cube Championship 2026! ​ [![](https://i.imgur.com/oRN01S9m.jpg)](https://beacons.ai/malaysiacubechampionship) ​ Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information. **Please note** Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, There will be **2 types of winner** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Malaysian Category** - Top 3 Malaysian winners of the competition Participants representing Malaysia will have the opportunity to win special trophies, prizes, and the title of Malaysia Champion. The number of competitors in all final rounds may increase until there are at least 6 Malaysian competitors who advance **If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Information & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaCubeChampionship2026#81105-information-announcements) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.** Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. • ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCLAWeeknightsI2026#83256-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Cubing Club @ UCLA](https://linktr.ee/cubing_club_at_UCLA?utm_source=linktree_profile_share&ltsid=88bd73bf-5f42-46f9-a65f-7b2ce5ede711). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMxMDQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--049a36d7432ebb69dbda8d946fe1c8bb0ea3974e/UCLA_Cube_Club_Logo_1%20(1).png)
